title: PT round-04, 2023 in biological discipline (Group - Biologically Derived Pharmaceutical)
bodyHtml:
IPC is going to conduct PT round-04,2023 in biological discipline (Group - Biologically Derived Pharmaceutical) for Identification by SDS-PAGE (Sodium Dodecyl Sulfate Polyacrylamide Gel). You are requested to find the attached registration form and send your consent with filled registration form on e-mail at qualityassurance-ipc@gov.in on or before 31st December 2023.
